parameters.content:
## Model Answer: Finding Niches That Need Automation

**Business researched today:** Jordan Lane, freelance automation consultant, researching the *Home Services* niche.

### 10 businesses shortlisted -> 5 researched in depth

| Business | Pain point found | Evidence | Automation opportunity | Market size (30mi) | Competition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coastal Air HVAC | Slow callback | 4 Google reviews mention "took 2 days to call back" | Missed-call text-back + lead routing | ~12 similar HVAC shops | Low |
| QuickFix Plumbing | Manual scheduling | Indeed posting for "part-time scheduler/data entry" | Auto-booking from web form to calendar | ~9 plumbing shops | Low |
| Home Comfort Heating & Cooling | No review pipeline | Only 14 Google reviews after 8 years in business | Automated post-job review request | ~12 HVAC shops | Medium |
| Rivera Electric | Manual dispatch | Owner mentioned on Facebook "juggling three jobs at once" | Multi-tech dispatch routing | ~7 electricians | Low |
| ProServe Home Repair | No CRM | No online booking, "call us" only on site | Lead capture -> CRM sync | ~10 handyman shops | Medium |

### Ranked top 2 (profit potential vs. effort to reach)
1. **HVAC & home services contractors** — strongest, most consistent evidence of pain (slow callbacks, no review pipeline), largest reachable market (~40 businesses), owners are reachable via LinkedIn/local FB groups.
2. Real estate (secondary track, revisit in Week 13 market expansion).

**Chosen niche for the rest of Week 11:** HVAC & Home Services Contractors — specific enough to write a targeted cold email tomorrow about missed-call recovery, not "small businesses" in general.
